claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: Text-only confirmation; no new photo/video or test results were provided.

risks.risk: Engine identity/variant may be wrong for the buyer’s vehicle (fitment risk) because engine code/ID is not readable.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of engine ID/engine code/label (engine block stamping and ECU label) and the part number plate if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/possibly wrong-fit used engine assembly (worst-case: buyer may need extra parts or it may not fit).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” may be inaccurate; internal mechanical issues may exist (bearings, timing, compression).
risks.proof: Video of cold start + short run with audible engine, plus compression test/leak-down readings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needing overhaul/repair).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; prior repairs could indicate hidden wear.
risks.proof: Close-ups of seal lines, bolt heads, and any tamper marks; plus any service/inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as previously opened/repair history unknown (worst-case: assume wear/repairs).

risks.risk: Incomplete assembly/accessories may be missing (sensors, mounts, hoses, starter/alternator, connectors).
risks.proof: Inventory checklist photo: show all included parts laid out and confirm connectors/sensors are present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer must source missing parts).

risks.risk: Damage from handling/shipping may exist (cracks, bent lines, broken mounts) not visible in current angles.
risks.proof: Walk-around video and close-ups of all mounting points, edges, and any suspected cracks/bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damage risk possible (worst-case: assume inspection/repair needed).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the engine ID/engine code/serial/label (engine block stamping + ECU label).
Send a short cold-start video (audio on) and a short run; ideally include a diagnostic scan result.
Send photos showing completeness: all included sensors/accessories/mounts laid out and close-ups of connectors.
If claiming Belgium origin, send import document/receipt or at least a photo of any label/marking that supports it.
response.reason: The seller’s new message is only a text assertion and does not add any verifiable evidence. Without engine identification and proof of testing, the item can’t be priced reliably beyond worst-case assumptions.
